_about: Field partner AI fragment (List 17 #160) — an annex on #58's follower system, NOT a new state machine. Assistance behaviours are REACT entries under three trigger classes PROPOSED into #58's trigger vocabulary (the vocabulary is #58's home; this package proposes, #58 disposes). Standing boundary: the partner sets no flags, collects nothing, and reads nothing for the Ranger — perception is presentation only, and assistance can never be the only path to any content. No species' reaction set instances these triggers yet.

assistanceTriggers.danger:<threatClass>: partner stages an alert toward a stocked presence (#7 table + #152 threatResponse); changes no probability, no band
assistanceTriggers.find:<itemClass>: partner indicates authored, uncollected #31 item presence in the area; never creates or collects
assistanceTriggers.sign:<kind>: partner alerts to and approaches a #89 sign (footprint | frost | trace); the read and its gates stay #89's

open_register: per-species reaction-set contents carrying the assistance triggers (content; distils with #152's profiles)
whether any non-principal follower is ever legal — not proposed here

perception.inputs: #152 wild view (curiosity, threatResponse) read through #108 temperament
perception.scope: presentation frequency and flavour only — a missed notice is a character beat, never a lockout

principal: the #58 roster-bound principal individual (#106 location.kind party | garden); no second follower proposed
statesAdded: none — FOLLOW / CATCHUP / IDLE / REACT / PARKED are #58's, unchanged
